skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic concepts of lexicology, including word formation, semantics, and fixed expressions.
Analyze and differentiate various types of word meanings, including synonyms, antonyms, and figurative language.
Conduct research on vocabulary usage in different contexts and prepare written reports.
Work effectively in groups to complete research projects and presentations.
Apply critical thinking to understand the historical development of English vocabulary and its variations.
Communicate effectively in English, using appropriate vocabulary and expressions.
